mainEntity.name: What's the difference between traditional abs exercises and functional core conditioning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional 'abs' exercises often isolate specific abdominal muscles, like crunches targeting the rectus abdominis. Functional core conditioning, conversely, trains the entire core musculature (abdominals, back, hips, glutes) to work together as a unit, typically through multi-joint movements that mimic real-life actions. At Cave Training, our functional approach ensures your core is trained for stability and power in dynamic situations, enhancing overall movement and athletic performance, rather than just isolated muscle strength. This holistic method improves how your body moves as a whole.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional abs exercises isolate muscles, while functional core conditioning trains the entire core as a unit through movements that mimic real-life actions, improving overall stability and power.
